title: Emergent BioSolutions Completes Repurchase of $75 Million Aggregate Principal Amount of Senior Unsecured Notes
summary: Repurchase reduces unsecured note balance to approximately $364.7 million Management to discuss this key milestone and broader transformation progress at upcoming investor conferences GAITHERSBURG, Md., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Emergent BioSolutions Inc.
